query: What SAA sample sizes and confidence/error thresholds will we require for inner/outer scenarios, and which importance-sampling scheme will target high-cost tail outages?

response.query: What SAA sample sizes and confidence/error thresholds will we require for inner/outer scenarios, and which importance-sampling scheme will target high-cost tail outages?
response.answer: For inner/outer scenarios, sample sizes and confidence/error thresholds depend on statistical power and significance; importance-sampling targets high-cost tail outages.
